This lets us proceed with the non-regulated, non-excluded tenants on Tuesday while Victor completes the classification work. Otherwise, we risk shipping something non-compliant.

Victor — can you commit to having the regulated tenant classification completed before Tuesday 02:00 UTC so we can definitively exclude any regulated tenants from the first cohort? And to everyone: any objections to this approach before I finalize?
